description: Generate a textured 3D avatar (GLB) from a text description or a reference image URL. Best for characters and figures. Renders inline in an interactive 3D viewer. Use this for a character that only needs to be viewed; when it must be posed or animated call forge_avatar instead.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key. Send the same key again (same caller, same arguments, within 24 hours) and you get the original job back instead of a second generation, so a retry after a timeout cannot burn quota twice. Use a fresh key for each distinct request. A failed attempt is not remembered, so its key can be reused.

image_url.description: Optional http(s) URL to a reference image to reconstruct in 3D.

prompt.description: Description of the avatar to generate.

name: text_to_avatar
title: Generate a 3D avatar
